mapper.select: SELECT org_id, daily_token_limit FROM organization_ai_budget WHERE org_id = #{orgId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_ai_budget (org_id, daily_token_limit) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{dailyTokenLimit}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE daily_token_limit = VALUES(daily_token_limit)
INSERT IGNORE INTO organization_ai_budget_usage (org_id, usage_day, consumed_tokens) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{usageDay}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT org_id, consumed_tokens FROM organization_ai_budget_usage WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND usage_day = #{usageDay} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_ai_budget_reservation (reservation_id, org_id, usage_day, reserved_tokens, expires_at) VALUES (#{reservationId}, #{orgId}, #{usageDay}, #{reservedTokens}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT reservation_id, org_id, usage_day, reserved_tokens FROM organization_ai_budget_reservation WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT al.actor_id AS userId, COALESCE(al.actor_label, 'System') AS displayName, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(al.changes, '$.feature')) AS feature, SUM(COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(al.changes, '$.inputTokens')) AS UNSIGNED), 0)) AS inputUsage, SUM(COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(al.changes, '$.outputTokens')) AS UNSIGNED), 0)) AS outputUsage FROM audit_log al WHERE al.org_id = #{orgId} AND al.action = 'ai.llm.call' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(al.changes, '$.outcome')) = 'success' AND al.created_at >= #{usageDay} AND al.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{usageDay}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY al.actor_id, al.actor_label, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(al.changes, '$.feature')) ORDER BY inputUsage + outputUsage DESC, displayName ASC, feature ASC
